lines.text: David asks the LORD to hear his groaning and says that in the morning the LORD hears his voice.
David says the LORD is not a God who delights in wickedness, and He abhors the man of bloodshed and deceit.
David says he will enter God's house by His loving devotion and bow toward His holy mountain.
David says his enemies' throats are open graves, and he asks God to drive them out because they have stolen from David.
David says the LORD blesses the righteous and surrounds them with the shield of His favor.
